effects.prompt: Put a card from your hand or arsenal on the bottom of your deck? (If you do, draw a card.)

_comment:
'When you defend with Crown of Providence, you may put a card from your hand or arsenal on the bottom of your deck. If you do, draw a card. / Blade Break' - Generic Equipment - Head.

BLADE BREAK NOT AUTHORED: it is in printed_keywords and fires from the card DB keywords field - re-authoring it would be a defect.

TRIGGER: ON_DEFEND is bridged from the engine 'defend' event and dispatched to the DEFENDING CARD ITSELF (engine._dsl_defend_listener, engine.py:1640-1646; play.py emits one defend event per declared defender at :1376), so defending equipment hears its own defend - no source-scoping condition needed (canopy_shelter_blue / battlefront_bastion precedent).

MAY = the printed 'you may': declining runs nothing in the block, so no draw (release note 2). MAY reads prompt/effects/else (effect_types.py:3788-3856).

HAND OR ARSENAL: no single primitive spans both zones (the cut_the_deck triage note says exactly this), so CHOOSE (effect_types.py:5107-5136) offers named options. PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM defaults player SELF and asks which hand card (effect_types.py:1557-1616); its default optional=True adds an extra decline inside the hand branch - harmless, since declining there just means nothing moved and no draw, which is already reachable by declining the MAY. PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM takes 'player': 'SELF' EXPLICITLY because the handler DEFAULTS TO OPPONENT (effect_types.py:2334, the Disable printings were its first users) - omitting the key would bottom the opponent's arsenal card, the exact defect recorded on sunkwater_exoshell.

'IF YOU DO': refs are scoped per ability execution (interpreter.run_ability push_refs), so sibling effects share them. PUT_HAND_CARD_BOTTOM sets ref 'bottomed_from_hand' ONLY when a card actually moved (effect_types.py:1610-1615); PUT_ARSENAL_BOTTOM sets 'bottomed' likewise (:2370-2376). The draw is a CONDITIONAL_EFFECT gated on OR(REF_EXISTS) over both names (handler at effect_types.py:3697-3724 reads when/then), copied from shipped mpg/sunkwater_exoshell.json whose comment explains why gating on 'arsenal non-empty' answers the wrong question. Empty hand AND empty arsenal -> nothing moved -> refs unset -> no draw, which is release note 1 verbatim.
